title: Install RStudio

blocks.what_we_do:
Install [RStudio Desktop](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) and open it.
Choose the build for your operating system. R must already be installed.
blocks.you_need: A working R installation from 0.2 and the RStudio installer.
blocks.command:
In the RStudio console, run this small calculation:

```{r s0-3_console}
2 + 3
```

Terminal equivalent: `Rscript -e "print(2 + 3)"`. The console and terminal
use the same R calculation. RStudio itself is opened through your applications menu.
blocks.expected_result: `[1] 5`. The `[1]` labels the first value printed; it is not part of the answer.
blocks.troubleshooting:
If RStudio cannot find R, check that R was installed for the correct processor.
Restart RStudio after installing R. A `+` prompt usually means an unfinished
command; press Escape and enter the complete command again.
blocks.quick_check:
After restarting R, should you expect an unsaved object to remain in memory?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>No. Reload it from a saved file or rerun the command that creates it.</details>
blocks.files_created: RStudio software files. No course data are created by the calculation.
